metadata.description: AI-powered audio-to-tablature transcription. Uses Demucs stem separation, Basic Pitch / YourMT3+ transcription, and dynamic-programming fingering optimization. Detects slides, hammer-ons, and pull-offs automatically.

version.author: Scott Mills
version.changelog: Initial release: Basic Pitch + YourMT3+ transcription, Demucs stem separation, technique detection (slides/hammer-ons/pull-offs), MIDI/tab/JSON export.
